Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; queues a new owner
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalizes ownership transfer
TokenBEP20 constructor; initializes metadata, supply and credits owner balance

totalSupply() view returns _totalSupply minus balances of address(0)
